highlights.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
highlights.contentSnippet: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.contentSnippet: Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare and Google each released an AI agent that hunts security bugs in source code. All 4 use the same find, disprove, then patch loop. Here is how they differ, plus 12 more tools. The post AI Security Agents Compared: Claude, Codex, Mantis, Cloudflare appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing with Cached Playwright Replays
highlights.contentSnippet: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

highlights.contentSnippet: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January. PageBreak uses Gemini models to autonomously investigate potential vulnerabilities, but reports them only after deterministic validators successfully reproduce the exploit against a running application. By Renato Losio

highlights.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
highlights.contentSnippet: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.

highlights.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing with Cached Playwright Replays
highlights.contentSnippet: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

highlights.title: Google Discloses PageBreak AI Security Agent That Found 500+ XSS Bugs
highlights.contentSnippet: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January. PageBreak uses Gemini models to autonomously investigate potential vulnerabilities, but reports them only after deterministic validators successfully reproduce the exploit against a running application. By Renato Losio
